existing_coverage.impact: Member Save/Discard now includes first-save organization resolution and persistence.
Admin Save/Discard now includes first-save organization resolution and persistence.
Save refusal/retry should assert an organization-resolution refusal retains the draft and exposes its remedy.

new_controls_proposed.label: First profile save organization
new_controls_proposed.action: For a profile with no existing row, resolve and explicitly persist the device's active organization; for an existing row, retain its stored organization.

new_cases_proposed.title: First profile save names active organization and existing profile stays filed
preconditions: Use a disposable profile with no existing row and a principal belonging to two organizations; then use a separate existing profile filed in the other organization.
steps: Set organization A on this device and save the new profile.
Switch this device to organization B and save an existing profile filed under A.
Repeat a new-profile save with no active device organization.
expected: Saving the existing row retains A and does not move it to B.
Without an active organization, no profile write occurs and the user receives the resolver remedy.

EXT-F-2004.name: Create and manage scheduled agenda tasks

existing_coverage.impact: Valid task creation now uses create_agent_task with explicit active organization; extend expected behavior to verify persisted organization and reload.

new_controls_proposed.label: Visible task-creation failure
new_controls_proposed.action: Show an alert with the resolver remedy or specific creation error; retain the open form for recovery.

new_controls_proposed.label: Task creation organization resolution
new_controls_proposed.action: Resolve and pass the active organization to the atomic create RPC; do not write if resolution fails.

new_cases_proposed.title: Task create carries selected organization or shows recovery remedy
preconditions: Use a disposable task and a principal belonging to two organizations.
steps: Set organization A on this device and create a task; inspect its organization and reload Agenda.
Clear the device organization or use a principal with no memberships and submit the form.
Restore an organization and retry from the retained form.
expected: The atomic RPC receives organization A and the created task persists in A.
A resolver refusal creates no task and displays a clear remedy while retaining the form.
A subsequent valid retry creates the task once.

existing_coverage.impact: Existing case is design-needed with empty steps/expected; specify org-bound capture, no-org refusal, and no-write behavior here.

new_controls_proposed.label: Capture organization resolution
new_controls_proposed.action: Resolve and pass active organization to edu_import_deck for capture; refuse before RPC if unavailable.

case_updates_proposed.title: Controlled manual execution: capture_study_set with organization handling
steps: Preview a controlled public study set and confirm preview writes nothing.
With organization A selected, capture and inspect the import request and resulting deck organization.
With no selected organization or membership, attempt capture and inspect the result and write count.
expected: Capture calls only edu_import_deck with p_organization_id equal to A.
Unavailable organization returns organization_required with a remedy and makes no RPC/write.

cross_cutting.profile_storage: Existing profile lookup failure is surfaced as a save error; organization selection occurs only when no existing profile row supplies one. This is database-dependent runtime behavior and remains unverified.
